cards.answer: Xayah is an AD-focused marksman who empowers her basic attacks and plants Feathers. She recalls those Feathers for physical damage and can root enemies hit by enough of them. Her ultimate briefly makes her untargetable.
cards.counterplay: Avoid standing between Xayah and her planted Feathers, and save key attacks for after her untargetability ends.

cards.counterplay: Sidestep the daggers and avoid the return paths of the Feathers they leave.

cards.answer: Deadly Plumage temporarily increases Xayah's attack speed and adds a weaker follow-up strike to her basic attacks. Hitting an enemy champion with that strike briefly grants her movement speed. Rakan also receives the empowerment if nearby when she casts it, and gains movement speed when she does.
cards.counterplay: Limit extended attack trades during the buff and respect her increased ability to chase.

cards.answer: Bladecaller pulls all planted Feathers back to Xayah, dealing physical damage along their return paths. An enemy hit by at least three Feathers is briefly rooted. Its damage increases with her critical strike chance, and she needs a Feather on the ground to cast it.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the paths between planted Feathers and Xayah before she recalls them.
